name: IAM Trust Policy Modification
description: An attacker with iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy can modify a role's trust policy to add their own principal (e.g., attacker account root or a user they control) as a trusted entity. Once the trust policy allows the attacker's principal, they can call sts:AssumeRole to obtain temporary credentials for that role. This enables backdoor access or cross-account privilege escalation. Required permission is iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy on the target role.
mitigations: Use SCPs to restrict AssumeRolePolicy modifications
